ranking_cost_comparison.interpretation: As currently defined, REAL and EN2 require the same Hamiltonian access pattern and the same number of candidate score evaluations. REAL uses slightly simpler arithmetic, but v50_5 does not treat that as a meaningful asymptotic resource advantage.

interpretation_boundary.claim: v50_5 tests whether REAL has a practical resource advantage over EN2 under the current implementation.
interpretation_boundary.important_limit: Both current scores require the same diagonal and reference-coupling Hamiltonian data. Any future resource advantage would require a different sparse/local estimator or search strategy, which is not introduced here.
